results.content: # Art lovers, creators connect at juried exhibition in Newport Beach. Artists had an opportunity Saturday to share their creative visions with an audience of art lovers — and perhaps sell an item or two — as the annual Newport Beach Art Exhibition capped Art Week. Organized by the city’s Arts Commission, the 59th juried exhibition allowed visitors to peruse more than 300 paintings, sculptures, photos and mixed media pieces at the Civic Center. “I hope airbrush works its way into fine art, since it’s a newer form of an ancient technique,” she said. Laguna Beach artist Cyrus Djahanshahi enjoyed his second year participating in the exhibition from a space on the patio that gave passersby views of his works. A children’s art and craft area made possible by Art in Motion allowed young artists in training to create their own masterpieces.
